paragraphs: Rabbi Yose bar Bun: Shocher Tov, section 133; Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of Berakhot, Shekalim, chapter 1, and Maaser Sheni, chapter 5. In Rabbi Avuna’s name: Challah, chapter 1. In Rabbi Vava’s name. Gamliel Zuga questioned him. Rabbi Hoshaya bar Shammai; Rabbi Hila; Zeaira; Rabbi Chiyya bar Luliani in Shammai’s name. In Rabbi Yochanan’s name: Terumot, chapter 3. In Rabbi Yose bar Chanina’s name. Kahana bar Malkhiyah transmitted in his name: Sheviit, chapter 3. In Rabbi Levi’s name: beginning of Bava Kamma. He reported Bar Pika’s question in Nazir, final chapter. In Rav’s name: Kilayim, chapter 1 and 4:4; Kiddushin 3:14; beginning of Yesh Muttarot. In Rabbi Shmuel bar Yitzchak’s name: Maaser Sheni, chapter 4. In Shammai’s name. Rabbi Shmuel was his son. Sedeh Yehoshua, end of Orlah, chapter 1, writes that Rabbi Yose be-Rabbi Bun is more prominent in this Talmud than Rabbi Zeaira: almost most of the Jerusalem Talmud is in his name; therefore Maimonides ruled like him.
